name: italix/documents
description: A versioned tree of documents with human names, projected onto a real directory you can edit with any tool

suggest.league/commonmark: Required by MarkdownRenderer; without it a tree still works, rendered as escaped text
suggest.dompdf/dompdf: Required by HtmlToPdfConverter; without it html->pdf routing reports unavailable
suggest.docling (Python, not Composer): Required by DoclingConverter for pdf/docx/pptx->md; a ~6GB venv, not a PHP dependency — see DoclingConverter's own docblock
suggest.poppler-utils (system package, not Compo: Required by PdfPageSplitter (pdfseparate), PdfMerger (pdfunite) and PdfToTextConverter (pdftotext); without it, they report unavailable
suggest.ext-pdo: Required: the tree, its history and its aliases live in a database
suggest.ext-zip: Required by Library::pack() to unpack and rebuild containers (ODF, OOXML, EPUB)
suggest.zstd and tar (system commands, not Compo: Required by Library::pack() and to read an archived version; without them pack() refuses and archived versions cannot be read
suggest.ext-zstd: A future alternative to the zstd command
suggest.italix/media: Its GdImageConverter re-encodes a saved page's images as WebP in SingleFileImporter; without an image converter they are kept
